findings.title: No guest accounts detected
findings.description: No Microsoft Entra guest accounts were present in the collected inventory.
findings.recommendation: Continue reviewing external identities as the tenant changes.

findings.title: Global Administrator assignments detected
findings.description: 1 account(s) were found in the Global Administrator role.
findings.recommendation: Minimize standing Global Administrator access. Use least privilege and privileged-access controls where available.

findings.title: Privileged role assignments detected
findings.description: 2 membership record(s) were found across the configured privileged roles.
findings.recommendation: Validate each privileged assignment against least-privilege requirements.

findings.title: Service principals inventoried
findings.description: 110 service principal(s) were collected from Microsoft Entra.
findings.recommendation: Review application identities periodically and restrict permissions to the minimum required scope.

findings.title: MFA registration status could not be verified
findings.description: The Microsoft Graph authentication-method registration report was unavailable.
findings.recommendation: Grant the required reporting permissions and rerun the collector. Do not interpret missing MFA data as MFA being enabled.
